Labels

Source: R/labeled.R
LabelClass.Rd

Label() is a label surrounded by a background box and a frame. LabeledLine() and LabeledArrow() put such a label at label_position (a proportion of the length) along a line or arrow. LabeledPolygram() puts it at the pole of inaccessibility of a polygram, the interior point farthest from its edges, stored in $pole with the distance in $radius.

Usage

Label(label, label_config = NULL, box_config = NULL, frame_config = NULL, ...)

LabeledLine(
  label,
  label_position = 0.5,
  label_config = NULL,
  box_config = NULL,
  frame_config = NULL,
  ...
)

LabeledArrow(
  label,
  label_position = 0.5,
  label_config = NULL,
  box_config = NULL,
  frame_config = NULL,
  ...
)

LabeledPolygram(
  ...,
  label,
  precision = 0.01,
  label_config = NULL,
  box_config = NULL,
  frame_config = NULL
)

Arguments

label

A string (rendered with MathTex()) or a mobject such as Text().

label_config

Named list of arguments for MathTex() when label is a string.

box_config

Named list of arguments for the BackgroundRectangle().

frame_config

Named list of arguments for the SurroundingRectangle() frame.

...

For Label(): passed to VGroup(). For LabeledLine() and LabeledArrow(): passed to Line() or Arrow() (start, end, ...). For LabeledPolygram(): vertex groups (one matrix or list of points per ring), then named arguments for Polygram().

label_position

Position of the label along the line, in [0, 1].

precision

Precision of the pole of inaccessibility search.

Value

A mobject: an R6 object of the class named by the function called. The objects whose names end in Class are the R6 class generators that these functions call.

Examples

Label(Text("Label Text"), box_config = list(color = BLUE, fill_opacity = 0.75))$scale(3)
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# A label given as a string is typeset with LaTeX.
LabeledLine("0.5", label_position = 0.8, label_config = list(font_size = 20),
            start = LEFT + DOWN, end = RIGHT + UP)
} # }
